format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Read the combined SSA baby names dataset
names_df <- read_csv("ssa-baby-names.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Filter for the chosen name and plot counts over time
names_df |>
  filter(name == "Avalee") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = count, color = sex)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Babies Named Avalee Over Time",
    subtitle = "U.S. Social Security Administration baby names data",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies",
    color = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
